_about: What the recipes in this folder share: the order Simple mode lists them in (ones not named here come after, by id), the caption prompts a recipe's caption.prompt names, and the photo guidance its photos names. Read by the engine (zentrainer/models/recipes.py), which serves them at GET /zentrainer/api/recipes for the web app to fetch as it starts: a change shows on a reload. A recipe's caption.prompt or photos can also be written out in full instead of named.

captions.nl: Describe this image for training an image model: the subject, their appearance, clothing and pose, the setting, lighting and photographic or artistic style. One detailed paragraph. Start directly with the description; no preamble.
captions.style: Describe what this image shows (subjects, objects, setting, composition, colours) in one paragraph, without naming or describing its artistic style, medium or technique. Start directly; no preamble.

tips: A few close-ups and a few full-body shots
Sharp photos: skip blurry or tiny ones
One subject or one look across them all
No text or watermarks if you can help it
All in the one style you want
No text or watermarks if you can help it
